summary: PAUSE import smoke tests passed. Backend 13/13 pytest cases green (health, 12 categories seeded, 493 stories, filters, detail 404, discover-batch, user state + interests + bookmark toggle persisted, limit-check, profile). Frontend end-to-end flow working on mobile viewport (390x844): onboarding profile -> name 'Mario' -> 'Continue as guest' -> topic picker (Animals + History selected via chip-{id}) -> Start discovering -> home deck renders with story card -> opening a card navigates to /deep-dive/{id} reader with chapters -> bookmark button toggles correctly (confirmed by 'Added to saved' toast and story visible in Saved tab). Profile tab shows stats (1 story, 1 day streak, 4 min), Premium CTA, content modes (Learn locked = premium-only mini-lessons), interests, theme. Topics (explore) tab loads. Zero pageerrors/red screens.

issues: Hero image shows empty gradient fallback on first open for some stories because object-storage upload happens in background at startup (expected per agent note). Will self-heal once covers are generated.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warnings: 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: multiple style files (e.g. /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:264 uses textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - find/migrate occurrences across components.
'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' Visual only on web preview; native build unaffected.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Migrate deprecated RN style props: replace textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius with the shorthand `textShadow` string across the codebase.
(Non-blocking) Replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents in affected components.
Stripe not configured (per project note): POST /api/purchases returns 503 'Payments not configured' - leave as-is unless premium checkout is in scope.
TTS disabled (TTS_ENABLED unset) as designed - reader works without audio playback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1500+ lines - consider splitting routes/models/services into modules in a future refactor (not blocking).
Routes correctly use /api prefix via APIRouter and depend on check_optional_services for graceful degradation of TTS/Stripe.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all projections.
Env vars correctly sourced via os.environ[] with hard failure on missing MONGO_URL/DB_NAME; frontend uses Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl / EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
testID coverage across onboarding, home, reader, tabs is excellent.
seed_data_creation: No seed changes. Reused existing CATEGORIES/STORIES seed (12 categories, 493 stories). Test user TEST_<uuid> created & cleaned up via Mongo in pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a working import of PAUSE (Expo RN mobile-first served via web preview). Guest flow works. Google OAuth not testable (no account). Stripe/TTS intentionally disabled. For UI tests use mobile viewport 390x844. Key testIDs: onboarding-profile-name, onboarding-profile-continue, chip-{category_id} (e.g. chip-animali), onboarding-continue, home-screen, home-story-{id}-open, bookmark-button, reader-back. Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Imported codebase runs correctly with only EMERGENT_LLM_KEY added to backend/.env.
